summary.intent: Fix a Greptile P2 review finding about a dead `None` arm and misleading error message in `crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs`, then push the fix to unblock CI.
summary.outcome: Added a `log::warn!` at the all-absent detection site in `verify_ipns_resolve_signature` and corrected misleading doc/inline comments; all 19 crate tests pass and the fix was committed and pushed.

Greptile P2: `bind_verified` `None` arm is unreachable from production post-D-04; fixed with log::warn at source + doc correction rather than type/verdict changes.

workflow: Fetch before push per a 'never-clobber-bot' rule to avoid overwriting bot commits.

When a Greptile finding touches code that is test-covered for defensive totality (not truly dead), the minimal safe fix is adding observability (log::warn) at the detection site rather than changing types or verdicts.
Always verify CI workflow files for deny-warnings gates before deciding whether to fix clippy warnings — they may not gate anything.
